title: Actions and their results: nouns from verbs

blocks.text: Actions and their results: nouns from verbs
-ение — -tion, -ence, -ance, -ity, etc. (suffix used to form abstract nouns from verbs, and occasionally from other parts of speech)

Wiktionary gives -ение one meaning: “-tion, -ence, -ance, -ity, etc. (suffix used to form abstract nouns from verbs, and occasionally from other parts of speech)”. So every word its etymologies build with -ение has it.

-ание — -tion, -ence, -ance, -ity, etc. (suffix used to form abstract nouns from verbs; added especially to verbs ending in -ать)

Wiktionary gives -ание one meaning: “-tion, -ence, -ance, -ity, etc. (suffix used to form abstract nouns from verbs; added especially to verbs ending in -ать)”. So every word its etymologies build with -ание has it.

-ие — Abstract noun suffix; forms part of larger suffixes such as -е́ние, -а́ние, -тие, and exists on its own especially as a suffix added to compound words.

Wiktionary gives -ие one meaning: “Abstract noun suffix; forms part of larger suffixes such as -е́ние, -а́ние, -тие, and exists on its own especially as a suffix added to compound words.”. So every word its etymologies build with -ие has it.
Wiktionary, «-ие» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ие#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
-ок — (productive suffix, colloquial, stressed, takes verbs, produces nouns) one occurrence of an action; separate act

(productive suffix, colloquial, stressed, takes verbs, produces nouns) one occurrence of an action; separate act — глота́ть (“to swallow”) + -о́к → глото́к (“swallow, gulp”); кива́ть (“to nod, to beckon”) + -о́к → киво́к (“nod”); зевать (“to yawn, to gape”) + -о́к → зево́к (“yawn, gape”)
-от — an action or the inclination to it; a physical state
«действия или склонности к нему, а также физического состояния или физиологического отправления» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of -от. Its examples: тошнота.
